How we handle information

Simple. Clear.
Transparent.

A straightforward explanation of the information you choose to share when contacting GS Enterprises Digital.

Information you provide

If you contact us by email or use the contact form, you may provide your name, email address, service interest and message.

How information is used

We use the information you choose to send to respond to your enquiry and discuss potential services.

Website form handling

The contact form opens your device’s email application with a prepared message. This website does not send form information to or store it on a website server.

Sharing and security

We do not sell personal information. Information shared with us by email is handled for the purpose of responding to your enquiry.

Contact

For privacy questions, email gsenterprises.digital@gmail.com.

Questions not covered here?

For questions about retention, deletion requests, analytics, cookies or other services not described in this policy, email gsenterprises.digital@gmail.com.

Need more clarity?

We're happy to answer questions about your information and how enquiries are handled.
